name: openbb_economy_interest_rate
description:
Interest rates by country from the OECD (call money, 3-month or 10-year) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.interest_rates).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (default united_states); duration (immediate, short or long; default short); start_date; end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (oecd; default oecd).
US overnight rates: openbb_fixedincome_effr, openbb_fixedincome_sofr; Treasury yields: openbb_treasury_rates. Keys: oecd needs none.
Example: {"country": "japan", "duration": "long"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
